name: Tiras
title: Japheth's youngest son
summary: Tiras was the youngest son of Japheth, who was one of Noah's three sons. He is mentioned in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogical record after the flood. Tiras is traditionally regarded as the ancestor of the Thracians or Tyrrhenians (Etruscans), peoples who settled in the regions around the Aegean Sea and the Mediterranean.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy after the flood
keyEvents.description: Tiras is mentioned as the seventh and youngest son of Japheth in the genealogy in Genesis chapter 10, known as "The Table of Nations".

keyEvents.title: Japheth's sons introduced
keyEvents.description: After the flood, Japheth's sons, including Tiras, became ancestors to the nations that spread across the earth.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Tiras is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy from Adam through Noah's sons, confirming his place in Israel's historical memory.

keyEvents.title: The scattering of the nations
keyEvents.description: Tiras and his brothers' descendants spread to their respective territories, each people with its own language and clans, in line with God's plan to fill the earth.

keyEvents.title: God's blessing on Noah's descendants
keyEvents.description: Tiras was part of the generation that received God's command to be fruitful, multiply, and fill the earth after the flood.
